comment: PLP-dependent aminotransferase acting twice in β-methylarginine biosynthesis: it converts L-arginine to 5-guanidino-2-oxopentanoate, the substrate of the C-methyltransferase ArgN, and transaminates the methylated keto acid to (2S,3R)-β-methylarginine, a residue of arginomycin.

reactions.description: Transamination of L-arginine with 2-oxoglutarate to give 5-guanidino-2-oxopentanoate
the product is the substrate of the C-methyltransferase ArgN
Transamination of (3R)-5-guanidino-3-methyl-2-oxopentanoate with L-aspartate to give (2S,3R)-3-methyl-L-arginine
L-aspartate is the amino donor; the product is incorporated into arginomycin
